cast.name: unnamed man

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The man in the video wears a polo shirt with "TRUMS" on it. As the post is from the @democrats account, the mockery of his supporter is implicitly directed at Donald Trump.

cultural_references: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
central_claim: A supporter of Donald Trump is being mocked for his high-waisted pants by comparing his appearance to the cartoon character SpongeBob SquarePants.
intended_effect: To make the viewer laugh at and ridicule the man shown, and by extension, Donald Trump and his supporters.
